facts.fact: The article states that global e-commerce sales are expected to increase by 28% from 2023 to 2026, citing Statista as the source of its retail e-commerce sales chart.
facts.quote: It’s expected that from 2023 to 2026, global e-commerce sales will increase by 28%.

facts.fact: The article outlines an online shopper journey of five stages: awareness, consideration, purchase, retention, and loyalty.

facts.fact: Discovery ads pose a question to the user to determine their interests or opinions on a chosen topic, and all clicks can be tracked to create retargeting pools.
facts.quote: Use discovery ads to pose a question to the user. This can determine their interests or opinions based on a topic you’ve chosen. All clicks can be tracked to create retargeting pools

facts.fact: Shoppable video ads showcase products in use while letting users browse within the banner, and products can click out directly to individual product pages.
facts.quote: This ad format showcases products in use while allowing the user to browse right in the banner. Shoppable video ads reduce the steps that a user must take between awareness and conversion.

facts.fact: Dynamic countdown ads are used to make an audience aware of sales and promotions and to create a sense of urgency to act.
facts.quote: With countdown ads, you can make sure your audience is aware of your sales and promotions. And a dynamic countdown unit will help create a sense of urgency
